findings.title: No failure-path tests: all 6 tests are happy-path
findings.detail: No test sends a non-OK response (409 slot conflict on booking, failed reschedule) to check the error snackbar and that nothing is invalidated; no onError branch is covered anywhere, including the hand-written one at index.ts:100. Add 409 cases for useCreateAppointment and useRescheduleAppointment and assert the error text renders.

findings.title: detailKey invalidates a key nothing registers
findings.detail: listKey appointmentKeys.all() already covers it (also :116); keep only because makeUpdateMutation requires it and fix the comment.

findings.title: flush() uses a fixed 50ms real sleep to prove no request was sent
findings.detail: Timing-dependent; assert on query fetchStatus idle or a waitFor on the handler spy.

findings.title: Mutation hooks invalidate appointmentKeys.all() instead of .lists()
findings.detail: Sibling useUsers.ts:33 invalidates userKeys.lists(); here create/cancel/reassign pass appointmentKeys.all() (lines 86, 107, 115), busting availability/schedule/token queries too. Intent is explained in-code; use .lists() if only the list should refresh.
